address: Ul. Ivana Pavla II 5, Đakovo, 31400, Croatia
bio: Located on a lively pedestrian street in the center leading to the striking Cathedral of St. Peter, this small, welcoming bistro is recognizable by its pleasant outdoor seating nestled in a shaded courtyard. The contemporary interior offers a relaxed atmosphere for enjoying regional cuisine reinterpreted with creativity and a modern touch. Don’t miss the chef’s signature take on Beef Wellington.
